items.criterion: The case study index lists only published case studies
items.judgment: Read the index and confirm every listed case study is published

items.criterion: A draft case study media object is refused to the public
items.judgment: Request a draft media object with no editor session and confirm the refusal

items.criterion: Two submissions with one idempotency key create a single enquiry
items.judgment: Submit twice with one key and confirm one enquiry row

items.criterion: A valid enquiry is persisted as one record
items.judgment: Submit a valid enquiry and confirm one row with the sent fields

items.criterion: The case study index narrows to one selected industry
items.judgment: Filter by an industry and confirm only matching case studies return

items.criterion: The experiments wall returns a page with a forward cursor
items.judgment: Read the wall and confirm a page carries a cursor for the next page

items.criterion: An anonymous caller is refused an editor endpoint
items.judgment: Call an editor endpoint with no session and confirm the refusal

items.criterion: A published case study media file is a stored object in the bucket
items.judgment: Load a published case study media object and confirm it exists in the store

items.criterion: A home headline resolves out of a character scramble, not a static line
items.judgment: A person watches the headline assemble from scrambled characters on first view

items.criterion: Submitting the enquiry lands on an acknowledgement page
items.judgment: A person submits a valid enquiry and sees an acknowledgement rather than a reset form
